params.body:
A route I used to render login variants locally came along with #21:

```php
Route::get('/tmp-login/{v}', function (string $v) { ... return view("tmp-login.$v", ...); });
```

The `tmp-login.*` views were never committed, so on production any URL under
`/tmp-login/` renders the error page. Nothing else reads it. Removed; the file
is otherwise identical to `main`.

Found while carving the next pull request, where the diff against `main` showed
the route as a removal. Sorry for the noise.
params.title: Een tijdelijke route die met #21 meekwam, weg
